lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾਇ ਬਸਿਓ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਵਤ ਧਰਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: man kaamanaa teerath jaai basio sir karavat dharaae ||
lines.translation: His mind's desires may lead him to go and dwell at sacred places of pilgrimage, and offer his head to be sawn off;

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੇ ਲਖ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: man kee mail na utarai ih bidh je lakh jatan karaae ||3||
lines.translation: but this will not cause the filth of his mind to depart, even though he may make thousands of efforts. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kanik kaaminee haivar gaivar bahu bidh daan daataaraa ||
lines.translation: He may give gifts of all sorts - gold, women, horses and elephants.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਨ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਭੂਮਿ ਬਹੁ ਅਰਪੇ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)n basatr bhoom bahu arape nah mileeai har duaaraa ||4||
lines.translation: He may make offerings of corn, clothes and land in abundance, but this will not lead him to the Lord's Door. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਦਨ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਰਤੁ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: poojaa arachaa ba(n)dan da(n)daut khat karamaa rat rahataa ||
lines.translation: He may remain devoted to worship and adoration, bowing his forehead to the floor, practicing the six religious rituals.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਿਆ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਇਹ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: hau hau karat ba(n)dhan mahi pariaa nah mileeai ih jugataa ||5||
lines.translation: He indulges in egotism and pride, and falls into entanglements, but he does not meet the Lord by these devices. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਸਿਧ ਆਸਣ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਏ ਭੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jog sidh aasan chauraaseeh e bhee kar kar rahiaa ||
lines.translation: He practices the eighty-four postures of Yoga, and acquires the supernatural powers of the Siddhas, but he gets tired of practicing these.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਗਹਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: vadee aarajaa phir phir janamai har siu sa(n)g na gahiaa ||6||
lines.translation: He lives a long life, but is reincarnated again and again; he has not met with the Lord. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਲੀਲਾ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਕਰਿਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaj leelaa raajan kee rachanaa kariaa hukam aphaaraa ||
lines.translation: He may enjoy princely pleasures, and regal pomp and ceremony, and issue unchallenged commands.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹਨੀ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਚੋਆ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਕਾ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sej sohanee cha(n)dan choaa narak ghor kaa duaaraa ||7||
lines.translation: He may lie on beautiful beds, perfumed with sandalwood oil, but this will led him only to the gates of the most horrible hell. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har keerat saadhasa(n)gat hai sir karaman kai karamaa ||
lines.translation: Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is the highest of all actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਹਨਾ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak tis bhaio paraapat jis purab likhe kaa lahanaa ||8||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, he alone obtains it, who is pre-destined to receive it. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਇਹ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tero sevak ih ra(n)g maataa ||
lines.translation: Your slave is intoxicated with this Love of Yours.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bhaio kripaal deen dukh bha(n)jan har har keeratan ihu man raataa || rahaau doojaa ||1||3||
lines.translation: The Destroyer of the pains of the poor has become merciful to me, and this mind is imbued with the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||Second Pause||1||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲੇ ੪ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag sorath vaar mahale 4 kee ||
lines.translation: Vaar Of Raag Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਜੇ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath sadaa suhaavanee je sachaa man hoi ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h is always beautiful, if it brings the True Lord to dwell in the mind of the soul-bride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੰਦੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਕਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਭੈ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: da(n)dee mail na kat man jeebhai sachaa soi ||
lines.translation: Her teeth are clean and her mind is not split by duality; the Name of the True Lord is on her tongue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਸੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਭੈ ਵਸੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਿਸੰਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: sasurai peeeai bhai vasee satigur sev nisa(n)g ||
lines.translation: Here and hereafter, she abides in the Fear of God, and serves the True Guru without hesitation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕਪੜੁ ਜੇ ਪਿਰ ਮਿਲੈ ਖੁਸੀ ਰਾਵੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: parahar kapaR je pir milai khusee raavai pir sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: Discarding worldly adornments, she meets her Husband Lord, and she celebrates joyfully with Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa seegaaree naau man kade na mail pata(n)g ||
lines.translation: She is adorned forever with the Name in her mind, and she does not have even an iota of filth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਰ ਜੇਠ ਮੁਏ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਸੂ ਕਾ ਡਰੁ ਕਿਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: devar jeth mue dukh sasoo kaa dar kis ||
lines.translation: Her husband's younger and elder brothers, the corrupt desires, have died, suffering in pain; and now, who fears Maya, the mother-in-law?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਰਮ ਮਣੀ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: je pir bhaavai naanakaa karam manee sabh sach ||1||
lines.translation: If she becomes pleasing to her Husband Lord, O Nanak, she bears the jewel of good karma upon her forehead, and everything is Truth to her. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਤਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਢੰਢੋਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath taam suhaavanee jaa har naam dha(n)dhole ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h is beautiful only when it leads the soul-bride to seek the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਾਵੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur purakh manaavai aapanaa guramatee har har bole ||
lines.translation: She pleases her Guru and God; under Guru's Instruction, she speaks the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਕਸਾਈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚੋਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har prem kasaaee dinas raat har ratee har ra(n)g chole ||
lines.translation: She is attracted to the Lord's Name, day and night, and her body is drenched in the color of the Love of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੈਸਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਗਤੁ ਮੈ ਟੋਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jaisaa purakh na labhaee sabh dekhiaa jagat mai tole ||
lines.translation: No other being like the Lord God can be found; I have looked and searched over the whole world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਡੋਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur satigur naam driRaaiaa man anat na kaahoo dole ||
lines.translation: The Guru, the True Guru, has implanted the Naam within me; my mind does not waver any more.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੋਲ ਗੋਲੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai gur satigur ke gol gole ||2||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is the Lord's slave, the slave of the slaves of the Guru, the True Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: too aape sisat karataa sirajanahaariaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are the Creator, the Fashioner of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh aape khel rachaai tudh aap savaariaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself have arranged the play, and You Yourself arrange it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: daataa karataa aap aap bhoganahaariaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are the Giver and the Creator; You Yourself are the Enjoyer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh teraa sabad varatai upaavanahaariaa ||
lines.translation: The Word of Your Shabad is pervading everywhere, O Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hau guramukh sadaa salaahee gur kau vaariaa ||1||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, I ever praise the Lord; I am a sacrifice to the Guru. ||1||
